notes.title: COME BACK HOME PLEASE RELEASE DATE AND STATUS UPDATE 2023
notes.content:
As you may know, creating a video game all by yourself takes time.

Aaand I can say I took my time and I'm on the verge of finishing the game. 
I started making it in 2020 when I was 16 years old. 
Now, after 2,5 years of work, stress, ups and downs the game is almost ready.

However...
I still need a few months to finish all the things needed. 
All I have to do is finish a few cutscenes and work on 2 unfinished boss-fights. 
I won't spoil how many boss-fights or cutscenes are in the final game, but promise me, you won't be disappointed.
I can say that the game will have three ways of playing through, about 3 hours each.
Soooo, you can say that to fully complete the game you will need about 7-9 hours. 

I plan on releasing the game at the end of this year or at the beginning of the next.
But, things may change. Maybe, it will be ready in a month, or maybe in six. What I plan however is to not drag the release date to more than a year from now.

That's all from me now, I just wanted to let you know that I'm still working hard on the game and you will not be disappointed.
More updates coming soon.

notes.title: Full controller support and visual changes - Demo Update 0.3.6
notes.content:
Visual changes:
-Changed tutorial text's color to make it easier to read.
-Changes camera angle in some of the levels.
-Other small visual changes.
Major changes:
-Added full controller support. (send me your feedback about how it works on Your controller, since I was only able to test in on my DualShock 4)

notes.title: Come Back Home Please Demo UPDATE 0.3.5
notes.content:
Changes:
-Added some controller mapping (as a solo dev i don't know if it fully works, because I tested it only on my dualshock4, you must try it out on your own gamepad, but I can tell you the game might be a bit easier on gamepad).
-Controller mapping should work on dualshock4 and Xbox One controller.
-The game now works at all resolutions.
Bug Fixes:
-Fixed the bug that caused some of the levels playthrough route impossible.
-Fixed the RESET button.

notes.title: Come Back Home Please Demo TUTORIAL UPDATE
notes.content:
I created a tutorial at the beginning of the game, so that you can jump into the levels easier.
If you had problems with understading the game's mechanics, just reset the game by pressing the "RESET" button in the menu and watch a quick tutorial!

Added:
-Tutorial at the beggining of the game
-Particle effect that appears when the Player uses a potion.
Bugs:
-Small bugs fixed.
